g.text: Standard development cost. Cost of the next purchase; terraformed resources = natural + 5 x terraforming.
Terraformed resources divide the cost rather than subtracting from it. Each row shares one scale, so the flattening to the right is the star's own resources doing the same job.
2.5 economy, 5 industry, 20 science, 50 warp gate. Fixed constants, not a setting.
the game's developmentCost tier: cheap 1, standard 2, expensive 4. No very- or crazy-expensive here.
what the star already has, so the n-th purchase is priced at current = n - 1. Hardcoded to 0 for a warp gate.
the channel's own terraformed resource. A warp gate uses the mean of all three - equal here, so the same number.
